model-value.desc: Date(s) of the component; must be Array if using 'multiple' prop; use v-model

default-year-month.desc: Default year and month (YYYY/MM) when model is unfilled

default-view.desc: The view displayed by default: Calendar, Months, or Years

multiple.desc: Allow multiple selection; model must be Array

emit-immediately.desc: Emit model when user browses month/year too (single selection only)

today-btn.desc: Display a button that selects the current day

landscape.desc: Display the component in landscape mode

events.desc: List of events to highlight on the calendar

navigation-min-year-month.desc: Lock navigation below a specific YYYY/MM

navigation-max-year-month.desc: Lock navigation above a specific YYYY/MM

no-unset.desc: Remove ability to unselect a date

color.desc: Color name from the Quasar Color Palette

square.desc: Removes border-radius so borders are squared

flat.desc: Applies a flat design (no default shadow)

bordered.desc: Applies a default border to the component

dark.desc: Notify the component that the background is a dark color

default.desc: This is where additional buttons can go

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the component needs to change the model; used by v-model

navigation.desc: Emitted when user navigates to a different month or year

range-start.desc: User has started a range selection

range-end.desc: User has ended a range selection
